top_signals.title: Dollar Ends Day at Lowest Since February as Bessent Aids Yen
top_signals.summary: The dollar finished the day at its weakest level in about seven months as the yen rallied after Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent challenged traders to test his resolve on supporting Japan’s currency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
top_signals.summary: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.
